entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-28
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • MSBuildWorkspace might not honor .editorconfig properly #80055
    Backlog
  • Case where old extensions cannot be converted to new extensions due to overloading by `ref` #79043
    Next

Updated

  • Extensions: betterness for static members should only consider type of extension parameter, not other modifiers #79171
    Next
  • Test plan for "extensions" feature #76130
    Next
  • "return" attributes on extension property accessors not emitted on implementation #80017
    Next
  • Potential ideas for ordering generators #80001
  • MissingUsings fixer not working with MSBuildWorkspace #80056
    18.0
  • [VMR] Ensure the VMR builds and publishes all of Roslyn #78298

PullRequests

Created

  • Update yml to support new signing requirements #80073
  • Do not create MEF services eagerly if they're not likely to be used right away #80072
    Area-IDE
  • Extensions: propagate return-targeted and local function parameter attributes #80070
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • [release/dev18.0] Don't switch runtime / design time solutions if cohosting is on #80066
  • Don't switch runtime / design time solutions if cohosting is on #80065
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Store client's version for open docs in LSP #80064
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Move the initialization of the global notification service #80062
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Don't count empty script extensions as potential script files #80068
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Fix issue reporting diagnostic in additional file when diagnostic produced by a source generator #80071
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode, Next
  • Always run the razor generator even in balanced mode #79510
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Reduce allocations from calling ITypeSymbol.AllInterfaces #79817
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Reduce allocations in DeclarationComputer #79782
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • EnC: Mark deleted members with an attribute #79764
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Extensions: propagate attributes on type parameters #80032
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Remove flag controlling if non-local diagnostics should be returned when getting diagnostics for a document. #80044
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Cache project analyzers #80050
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80067
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • [Backport] Always run 'required' generators: #80058
    VSCode

Updated

  • Update debugger packages, move to PortableInterop IMetadataImport #80063
    Area-Interactive, Community
  • Use apphost for core compiler #80026
    Area-Compilers
  • Pin SDK to .NET 10 Preview 7 #80020

  • Reduce allocations in DiagnosticDescriptor.GetEffectiveSeverity #79831
    Area-Compilers
  • Ensure that refkinds are rewritten for complex methods #79916
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce alllocations in AnalyzerExecutor.GetAddDiagnostic #79657
